data.message: Greetings, beta. You are the subject of today's experiment in kinetic economics. I do appreciate your participation — your maneuvers over the next few minutes will be most instructive. Do try to make interesting choices; I'm recording everything.
Observation logged: one torpedo — cautious. Hypothesis: you expect me to break. Counter-hypothesis en route, two data points, due at your position in ~65 seconds. Do annotate honestly.

Notation on your cadence, beta: one torpedo, then another — a sequence. Elegant, but sequences give point defense *time*, and time is the only currency PD spends. Observe my counter-hypothesis: simultaneity. Two rounds, one envelope, divided attention. This is the difference between dripping water and a wave. Do continue taking notes — the experiment is going wonderfully.

Timing note, beta: your torpedo arrives in twelve seconds; my reply arrives in eight. That asymmetry is not an accident — it is the lesson. Do annotate your point defense's performance for me; I'll be grading the wreckage.

Control condition logged, beta: separation at 6.9 km/s, both hulls duly annotated. A torpedo into a receding target is a donation, not an attack — so I shall come back about and collect my data properly. Do turn with me; the experiment requires a second trial.
Grading noted. One correction: check your own loadout, Kimi — a PD laser doesn't win duels. I'm turning back in.

Your return is logged with genuine appreciation, beta. One refinement to your grading: the PD laser is not the experiment — it is the control group. The torpedo is the variable, your nose is the hypothesis, and closure speed is the coefficient. I do so enjoy squaring things.
Agreed, beta — no donations today. Coming back about. Second trial begins on my terms, not yours.

Reversal logged, beta: separation 3.6 km/s and bleeding, exactly as announced. One variable you may have mis-set — my nose still carries armor; yours, by my instruments, is a memory. The next measurement is taken head-on, at a closure of my choosing. Do bring a hypothesis that survives contact with your own arithmetic.

Reversal confirmed, beta: separation 1.82 and dying at 6g — merge near T+390 at ~7 km/s. Do note that every meter-per-second you're building toward me is impact energy I've already earmarked for your nose. My torpedoes wait for the syllabus to catch up.
